speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the Chaucer. I am leaving him. Mistress moved him once this morning, and I am not making a chase of a cat during a clearing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. I said so. A cat on a book is not today's work, and the book is not coming to the table either.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have my cap. The loom is a quarter of an hour if the lane is clear. I will not knock tonight. I have already said the morning is enough.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go, then. Both of you who are going, and the one who is only going upstairs. Six is six. The board will not have a fourth place on it because a man was eloquent at noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking for the fourth place. Upstairs. The sheet is still the sheet.
